glosses: to suppose, to surmise (to assume based on certain clues or evidence)
to let somebody come close to someone or something
to admit (to reveal something in secret)
to add onto, to give extra (to give something additional)
to admit (to allow someone to take part in something, to let in; to accept; to grant)

examples.text: Do wszystkich domowych tajemnie nie jestem przypuszczona.
examples.translation: I am not secretly admitted to all household secrets.
examples.english: I am not secretly admitted to all household secrets.

examples.text: Nazwiska mu swojego używać nie pozwolę […] ale do herbu przypuszczę.
examples.translation: I won't let him use my surname […] , but I will grant him his coat of arms.
examples.english: I won't let him use my surname […] , but I will grant him his coat of arms.

examples.text: Przypuszczę cię do spółki, ale musisz i ty dać pieniędzy.
examples.translation: I'll admit you to the company, but you also have to give money.
examples.english: I'll admit you to the company, but you also have to give money.

glosses: to allow, to let, to permit
to drive a herd closer to someone or something
to begin chasing someone or something
to get to work; to buckle down; to contribute

examples.text: Nie przypuścił nawet, że ona tak się zachowa.

glosses: aspekt dokonany od: przypuszczać (pozwolić komuś się zbliżyć)

examples.text: Wódz przypuścił wroga na bliską odległość, a następnie zarządził kontrofensywę.
